causes.label: The ULTRA HANDWASH, DELICATES or CASUALS cycle was chosen
remedies: This is normal.
The washer alternates between agitate and soak during the ULTRA HANDWASH, DELICATES and CASUALS cycles to get your clothes cleaner with less wear.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "The ULTRA HANDWASH, DELICATES or CASUALS cycle was chosen"

causes.label: The highest SOIL LEVEL setting was chosen
remedies: The highest SOIL LEVEL setting adds a 15 minute Stain Wash agitate and soak period at the beginning of the wash cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "The highest SOIL LEVEL setting was chosen"

causes.label: Control panel is asleep
remedies: This is normal.
Press POWER to activate the control panel.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Control panel is asleep"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Check controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up.
remedies: Close lid and reset cycle, to the beginning if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up."

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Electronics need to be reset
remedies: Unplug washer, wait 2 minutes, plug back in and press POWER.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Electronics need to be reset"

causes.label: START was not pressed
remedies: Press START.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "START was not pressed"

causes.label: Extremely low water pressure
remedies: Press START again.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Extremely low water pressure"

causes.label: Washer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Start
remedies: If the light on the DELAY START pad is flashing, the washer is paused.
Press START to restart the countdown.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Washer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Start"

causes.label: Washer is uneven
remedies: To level the front of the washer, adjust the front leveling legs by rotating the individual leg in the proper direction for up or down.
To level back of washer, lift back of machine 4″ (11 cm) and set down.

causes.label: Washer load is unbalanced
remedies: Press START to pause the washer, open the lid and redistribute the load evenly.
Close the lid and press START again.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Washer load is unbalanced"

causes.label: Shipping rod is still assembled in unit
remedies: To remove shipping rod from washer, pull yellow tag and attached rod from the bottom right hand side of washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Shipping rod is still assembled in unit"

causes.label: Washer is sitting too close to wall (causes knocking during cycle)
remedies: Pull washer away from the wall; about 4″ (11 cm) is needed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Washer is sitting too close to wall (causes knocking during cycle)"

causes.label: PerfecTemp Plus feature is being used
remedies: This is normal.
PerfecTemp Plus turns water valves off and on to adjust water temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "PerfecTemp Plus feature is being used"
